title: Necrotopia — Apocalypse in Las Vegas
blurb: Act 1 of the Storyline Arc. The sky has split, Heaven and Hell are at war, and you took shelter in the worst possible place: a 24-hour Las Vegas wedding chapel. Now something is pounding on the doors.

vegas.name: Las Vegas — The Apocalypse
vegas.description: Neon and fire. The Strip is coming apart as the war between Heaven and Hell pours onto Earth.
